title: Scaling and linearizing data with logarithms

moments.title: Introduction
moments.text: Start the video on Non-Linear Regression.

ican.text: I can explain the main ideas and use the notation for scaling and linearizing data with logarithms.
I can apply these ideas, show my working and check the result.

ku.text: A power model $y=ax^b$ becomes $\ln y=\ln a+b\ln x$ for positive $x,y$.
An exponential model $y=ab^x$ becomes $\ln y=\ln a+x\ln b$, with $a,b>0$.
Plot the transformed variables and interpret the fitted line using the chosen axes.

misc.weak: Reading the intercept of a log-transformed graph directly as $a$
misc.better: If the intercept is $\ln a$, exponentiate it to recover $a$.

terms.text: Give a reason that connects the mathematical idea to the situation.
Show enough working to make your method and answer clear.

worked.prompt: A graph of $\ln y$ against $\ln x$ is $Y=2X+\ln3$. Give the original model.

kq.q: What mistake should I check for?
kq.model: If the intercept is $\ln a$, exponentiate it to recover $a$.
